platformCheckTemplates.page-states: Exercise this page's actual loading, empty, error/retry and successful states, including navigation and reload.
platformCheckTemplates.page-access: Verify the page's declared public/authenticated/admin access policy and cross-user resource boundary.
platformCheckTemplates.page-persistence: Submit applicable page actions, verify the corresponding backend result, and reload to confirm durable state; verify failed writes do not show success.
platformCheckTemplates.control-behavior: Operate this exact control with real user events; assert the visible result and the intended handler/API request, including disabled and invalid-input behavior.
platformCheckTemplates.control-failure: Force the control's request/dependency to fail or time out; verify error/retry/cancel behavior and that no unconfirmed success or duplicate mutation is shown.
platformCheckTemplates.response-contract: Call the exact registered method/path and assert status, content type and response schema for successful, empty and nonexistent-resource cases as applicable.
platformCheckTemplates.access-policy: Establish and test this endpoint's declared anonymous/authenticated/admin policy; reject unauthorized requests without leaking protected data.
platformCheckTemplates.input-boundaries: Test actual path/query/body boundaries and malformed or excessive input; assert validation occurs before side effects. Record explicit non-applicability for absent inputs.
platformCheckTemplates.tenant-boundary: For scoped resources, use distinct fixture identities to prove ownership/tenant isolation on both reads and writes.
platformCheckTemplates.dependency-failure: Make each required database/storage/provider dependency fail or time out; assert an honest bounded failure and preserve retryable state.
platformCheckTemplates.mutation-durability: Verify the real mutation with durable readback/reopen, transaction rollback on failure, idempotent retries and concurrent delivery where applicable.
platformCheckTemplates.deletion-durability: Verify ownership, durable removal and retained/reference cleanup; repeated deletes and interrupted cleanup must not resurrect or erase another user's data.
platformCheckTemplates.callback-integrity: Verify applicable provider signature/state/nonce, replay and duplicate-event handling against the actual callback handler and stored state.
platformCheckTemplates.readiness-truth: Prove required child/dependency capability before ready=200; unloaded/unavailable capability must remain unavailable and recover only after actual readiness.
platformCheckTemplates.artifact-integrity: Validate the delivered artifact's declared format, decode/content constraints, ownership, durable bytes and retry/delivery receipt; distinguish procedural output from learned quality.
platformCheckTemplates.dns-wire-contract: Exercise actual DNS question/type/record handling, response RCODE/flags/TTL and serialized wire bytes; assert malformed-packet and unsupported-query behavior.
